trackedAcceptanceCriteria.text: **AC-PB-001:** The Playback parameter exposes Off = 0 and On = 1; setting 1 requests playback on, and setting 0 stops playback, rather than treating each trigger as a toggle.
trackedAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: Production parameter definition and idempotent On/Off callback traces in verifyEntryAndLifecycle and verifySharedPlaybackParameter.

trackedAcceptanceCriteria.text: **AC-PB-002:** The left encoder and Playback parameter control one shared on/off state; successive left-encoder presses toggle the parameter between On = 1 and Off = 0.
trackedAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: Production custom-UI and offset API v13 setter traces in verifyTimelinePlaybackToggle and verifySharedPlaybackParameter.

trackedAcceptanceCriteria.text: **AC-PB-003:** Preset saving includes the shared Playback parameter value through normal parameter persistence.
trackedAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: HostDouble generic parameter images, both restoration orders, legacy migration, and 1–5 MB/full-5 MB round trips.

trackedAcceptanceCriteria.text: **AC-PB-004:** Setting Playback to On when there is nothing to play leaves its value at 1 and produces no playback; it does not automatically reset to Off.
trackedAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: Unavailable-selection production parameter trace in verifySharedPlaybackParameter.

trackedAcceptanceCriteria.text: **AC-PB-005:** Selecting a valid loop while Playback remains On begins playback under existing clock timing without another Off/On action.
trackedAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: Later-selection and fresh two-pulse acquisition trace in verifySharedPlaybackParameter.

specRequirements.label: 5. Host compatibility, persistence and real-time safety

verificationSeams.evidence: verifyEntryAndLifecycle, verifyTimelinePlaybackToggle, verifySharedPlaybackParameter, and emergency-control traces exercise production factory, callback, parameter-offset, audio-setter and UI-setter adapters.
Range-motion arithmetic plus production custom-UI/draw/framebuffer traces cover zoom invariance, fine edits, boundary retrieval/handles, PPQN text and timing invariance.

verifyOneShotClearRecording covers one-shot/rearm behavior, capture preservation, ordered cleanup, stale-state invalidation, four history-metadata operations, no allocation, full 5 MB history and all 2,048 note plus 16 sustain ownership slots.
Shared-control and complete-preset suites cover valid new and legacy images, generic-before-custom and generic-after-custom restoration, exact reserialization, silent load and two fresh clock pulses.

The integrated callback suite retains clock, reset, panic, routing/filtering, capture exclusion, scheduler, pending-range, ownership, persistence, timeline/navigation and cleanup regressions; range_motion_test retains fixed-size arithmetic.

make verify runs optimized native production tests, ASan/UBSan, Cppcheck, blocking-I/O/logging source inspection, this manifest validator, ARM Cortex-M7 builds, ELF/pluginEntry checks and a strict reviewed undefined-symbol allowlist.

evidenceBoundaries.nativeAndEmulator: Host-double MIDI/framebuffer traces and measured payload/timing observations are synthetic native evidence only and do not establish firmware budgets.
evidenceBoundaries.arm: The built artifact is inspected as an ELF32 little-endian ARM relocatable object exporting pluginEntry; only reviewed API v13 host/JSON and libc imports are allowed.
evidenceBoundaries.physical: Physical disting NT evidence remains exclusively in docs/HARDWARE_SMOKE_TEST.md and docs/UX_REFINEMENT_HARDWARE_TEST.md; make verify does not claim it.
evidenceBoundaries.excluded: No publication, firmware-owned corrupt-preset behavior, MIDI-file export, older-firmware support or expanded physical compatibility claim is included.
